Outstanding!
Mar 2025 • Couples
Firstly I’d like to say thank you to Xavier and his staff for a lovely experience in Ho Chi Minh City for their friendly approach making you feel very welcome in Cocotte, a truly beautiful restaurant.
We were both blown away with the quality of food and drinks at a very reasonable price. Signature dish is the French Onion soup covered in Emmental cheese which tasted like a traditional dish. We also had the Tuna with Wasabi beurreblanc and the beef ravioli, both were excellent and washed down with a very nice bottle of Cremant which was excellent.
Many thanks for a great evening.

Decent place for decent French cooking at decent prices!
Apr 2024 • Friends
After scouting around Ho Chi Minh city centre for a decent restaurant that has the facilities to cater to a small group dinner meeting at very short notice, I finally decided to try out Cocotte SILA. The reasons were quite compelling: (1) they have quite a decent menu including different choices of set meals for small groups of pax; (2) they have a private space upstairs that can easily offer dining and meeting space for up to 40 pax, and even has a projector and screen if we needed to do any PPT presentations; and (3) their restaurant manager, Mr Long, was extremely patient, helpful, and obliging to meet any special requests we had. When the time came for our small group to meet for dinner, we were certainly not disappointed by the quality of the French food they served. Its location is also easy to find, and it is part of an apartment hotel. The prices of their dishes and set meals are also quite reasonable.
